EXTRAORDINARY
NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 66c OF THE AMENDED LOCAL GOVERNMENT
AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (AMENDMENT) No. 22 OF 2012

I, H. M. M. U. B. Herath, the Commissioner of Local Government of Central Province, do hereby notify that the firstmeeting is tendered to nominate Mayors/Chairmen, Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen for the Local Government Institutionsof Central Province, mentioned in the Schedule below in the date, time and in the centers stipulated in the Schedule, byvirtue of power vested in me under Section 66c of the Amended Local Government Authorities Election Ordinance(Amendment) No. 22 of 2012.
H. M. M. U. B. HERATH,Commissioner of Local Government,
Central Province.Department of Local Government,Central Province,16th March 2018,
